rationale.conceptual: All necessary equations (V(y), γ_yz, W_pl(ε), Φ, gain) are provided exactly; the agent only needs to evaluate them numerically with given parameters and perform trivial unit conversions. There is no need to derive anything, design a method, or apply any non‑trivial algorithm.
rationale.execution: The entire workflow consists of a few sequential calculations inside one Python script, producing one JSON and one CSV file. There is no pipeline orchestration, no external tooling, no data fetching, and no fragile dependencies.

difficulty.reasoning: The task requires only implementing a handful of analytical formulas given explicitly in the paper; the agent merely translates closed‑form equations into code, with no novel algorithm or deep domain understanding. The pipeline is a single script producing two small output files, so both conceptual and execution difficulty are minimal.

compute_estimate.reasoning: Purely analytical evaluation of a few formulas; no dataset, no training, no large arrays; memory usage is negligible.
